correctness.rationale: Exact Voronoi-cell argument proves mu^2=6/5. For every path frame all packet partial sums are binary after a common 0/1 shift, giving a rational containing sphere <=6/5. Xue's Proposition 2.4 proves mu<=kappa. Conversely every subset sum of an optimal frame has even squared norm <=4; row sign exclusivity excludes norm-four generators and forces an oriented Hamiltonian root path. 120 count follows, and a standalone exact integer check enumerates 230300 candidate frames and 2880 packet witnesses.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial rank-four A-type root lattice yields a complete evaluation of the newly introduced original common-frame radius, with its entire set of 120 minimizing bases. It gives a structural contrast to the nearby four-dimensional D4 gap and a reusable two-level Voronoi/binary-path fitting mechanism. The result is a natural full classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of the covering radius alone.
